changes.reason: EventBusConfig records each successful detach during bus replacement so a failed replacement can be recovered using the existing process-local configuration.

kubernetes.reason: Recovery updates the process-local subscription map through the existing EventBus contract. It needs no Node Host capability, storage or Kubernetes lifecycle integration.
constraints: Recovery stays in the current application scope and uses synchronous EventBus subscription calls.

aws-lambda.reason: Recovery uses the same in-memory subscription state without an invocation hook or storage across Lambda invocations.
constraints: Recovery stays in the current application scope and uses synchronous EventBus subscription calls.

cloudflare.reason: Recovery needs no Workers binding, durable state or isolate lifecycle hook.
constraints: Recovery stays in the current application scope and uses synchronous EventBus subscription calls.
